gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan reads wide and friendly, with big lowercase forms. Mystery Quest, the display heading, brings a bookish, nostalgic lilt, and that gap between old-fashioned and contemporary is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Mystery Quest is all open jaws, every curved stroke gaping a little, like a storybook title page. Noto Sans Elymaic follows over a long read, smooth and modern.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Noto Sans Ethiopic reads modern and sturdy, its c terminals hanging well away from the bowl. Mystery Quest, a bookish display face, would feel cramped if made small, while the sans-serif body handles the everyday work.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian has open curves throughout the alphabet and short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. And over a long page it keeps a modern, clean feel, while Mystery Quest supplies the nostalgic, bookish heading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-glagoliti: Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curve, bookish and nostalgic. Make it small and that character gets lost, while Noto Sans Glagolitic stays approachable, with round letters that read clearly even at modest sizes.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Mystery Quest puts nostalgic, bookish display letters up front, with compact ascenders over tall lowercase. Noto Sans Gothic sits beneath with counters like drilled glass beads, round forms that read like open parentheses on the page.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha has tall little letters, like pen-nib bowls pressed flat, so reading never snags on a closed-up bowl. Mystery Quest earns its keep big and short.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Noto Sans Gujarati ends its curves before they turn inward, leaving generous counters in tall a, e and s. Over many lines it feels clean and modern, a steady companion for Mystery Quest's bookish, nostalgic heading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-g: Contemporary and modern, Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has lowercase strokes as tall as a thick crayon mark, with terminals cut back to leave a big gap. Mystery Quest adds a nostalgic heading, and reading stays light.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic display letters, their open jaws on every curve. But Noto Sans Gurmukhi keeps a clean, professional tone, its outward-pointing terminals like tongs holding steady through a long read.
